summary.description: Three to four sentences: the overall risk of this change plus a short rationale referencing the criteria that drove the findings.

criterion.description: Which of the five review criteria this finding belongs to; null if untagged or unrecognized.

severity.description: Impact level of the issue: blocker, high, medium, or low.

filePath.description: File path as it appears in the diff.

lineNumber.description: Affected location as a single line ("42") or an inclusive range ("10-15"); null if not line-specific.

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.

findings.description: High-confidence, actionable issues; empty array if none.

nitpicks.description: Minor style or readability notes; empty array if none.

model.description: The actual model that produced the review, resolved even when 'auto' was requested.

tokensIn.description: Total input tokens consumed across the run.

tokensOut.description: Total output tokens produced across the run.

aiCredits.description: AI credits (AIC) consumed, derived from Copilot nano-AI units; absent when the provider does not report usage (e.g. BYOK). USD is not exposed by the SDK.

cost.description: Token and credit usage for the run, plus the model used.

decision.description: Overall gate decision derived from the findings' severities.

pass.description: The single boolean the CI job gates on; false only when decision is 'blocked'.

verdict.description: Gate verdict derived deterministically in code from the findings' severities (not emitted by the model).
